title: Meditative balance changes IV
notes: Issue #2179's balance changes. Rules: an Indestructible unit is never in Defense Position (R2179000); Temporary takes a number, Temporary X (R2179001); a card cast on draw, like an Echo's repeat, is no play, so nothing that counts or answers plays sees it (R2179002); KY's Test's Easy problems are four-digit sums or differences, its old Hard problems Medium and its Hard ones new (R2179003); Playtester adds a random Book (R2179004); Anime Armor's cap guards the unit itself (R2179005). The other cards' changes are catalog data or kept v0.4.12d scripts (R767000). No win rates were measured for it.

player.title: Meditative balance changes IV
balance: Conjure Bones' Embiggened version shuffles in 14 Bone Storms, down from 17.
Book of Nerf Nerfs 4 times (Radiant 8), down from 5 (10).
Catboy Maid SSR+ adds 1-2 to your Jade Counter (Radiant 1-4), down from 1-3 (1-6).
Joon Jorker Buffs 4 times (Radiant 8), down from 5 (10).
Wondrous Wand's drawn cards cost (1), up from (0); its Radiant face's cost (0), and its Embiggened version draws 4, down from 5.
The Power to Punish costs (3), up from (2).
Spiritually 中国 costs (4), up from (3).
changes: Indestructible Units can't be in Defense Position, and still never have Taunt.
Temporary can take a number: a Temporary X card counts down at the end of each of your turns and is discarded at 0.
A card cast on draw is not a card played, as an Echo's extra casts never were: Combo, Jackiestan Auctioneer and every card that counts or answers plays ignore it.
Tranquility exiles itself.
Knowledge Breaker no longer Nerfs cards in decks.
Felinor Fuser Discovers (2) Cost or less Felinor Units (Radiant (3) Cost or less).
Transmogulate replaces your hand and deck; Embiggened for (4), your board too. It no longer reaches your graveyard or exile.
KY's Test's Easy problems are four-digit sums and differences, its old Hard problems are Medium, and its new Hard problems are doctoral.
Devil's Pact's Radiant face replaces your cards with base Books of Flame.
Playtester adds a Book of Buff or a Book of Nerf at random, with no choice.
State of the Game is Immutable.
Magic Amplifier can be Embiggened for (2), adding a random Spell or Field Spell that deals damage to your hand.
Prep can be Embiggened for (2), also drawing the highest cost Spell from your deck.
Anime Armor can't take more than 1 damage at a time either.
Dropshipping gives its cards Temporary 2 instead of Brittle 2.
The Power to Punish deals Pierce damage.
Spiritually 中国 does all three of its effects, and its Radiant face is printed in English.
Radiant Saintess's Radiant face has Reborn and no longer makes your hand Radiant.
Book of Buff's normal face only Buffs a permanent.
Claude's Datacenter adds its card with an Activate instead of at the end of your turn.
